name: velociraptor
description: Velociraptor DFIR server running in Docker (xboarder56 fork), adapted for Unraid. Multi-arch image: linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. Mapped services: - Frontend / client ingress: 8000/tcp - API / gRPC gateway: 8001/tcp - Web GUI (HTTPS): 8889/tcp - Prometheus metrics: 8003/tcp Persistent path: - /mnt/user/appdata/velociraptor -> /velociraptor (config, keys, artifacts, repacked client bundles — all stored here) First run: The container auto-generates server.config.yaml and client.config.yaml and repacks Linux (.deb/.rpm amd64+arm64), macOS (amd64+arm64) and Windows (.exe/.msi) clients into /velociraptor/client_bundles/. A small build banner (version, arch, base image, git commit, build date) is printed to the log on every start. Login: Open https:// :8889, accept the self-signed TLS certificate and log in with the credentials set via VELOX_DEFAULT_USER / VELOX_DEFAULT_PASSWORD. Change them immediately after first login! Security: - TLS is self-signed by default; rotate keys/certificates from the Velociraptor GUI. - Keep API port 8001 and metrics port 8003 restricted to trusted networks only. - VELOX_DEFAULT_USER/PASSWORD are only used for the initial bootstrap user. Troubleshooting: docker logs -f velociraptor docker exec -it velociraptor sh Source: https://github.com/Xboarder56/velociraptor-docker Fork of: https://github.com/weslambert/velociraptor-docker (Wes Lambert)

paths.name: Velociraptor Data
paths.description: Persistent data directory: config, keys, artifacts and repacked client bundles are all stored here.

ports.name: Frontend / Client Ingress
ports.description: Velociraptor frontend/client ingress port. Clients connect here.

ports.name: API / gRPC Gateway
ports.description: Velociraptor API/gRPC gateway port. Restrict to trusted networks only.

ports.name: Web GUI (HTTPS)
ports.description: Velociraptor Web GUI. Open https:// :8889 in your browser.

ports.name: Prometheus Metrics
ports.description: Prometheus metrics endpoint. Restrict to monitoring network if not needed publicly.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone, e.g. Etc/UTC or America/New_York.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Bootstrap admin username for the Velociraptor GUI. Change after first login.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Bootstrap admin password. Change immediately after first login!

variables.name: Admin Role
variables.description: Role assigned to the bootstrap user (e.g. administrator, analyst, investigator).

variables.name: Frontend Hostname
variables.description: Public hostname clients use to reach the server. Set to your Unraid IP or FQDN.

variables.name: Frontend Port
variables.description: Public-facing port clients use to reach the server (built into client URL).

variables.name: Frontend Server URL (override)
variables.description: Full client URL override, e.g. https://ingest.example.com:8000/ — overrides Hostname/Port/Scheme if set.

variables.name: GUI Hostname
variables.description: Public hostname for the admin GUI. Defaults to Frontend Hostname if not set.

variables.name: GUI Port
variables.description: Public-facing port for the admin GUI.

variables.name: GUI URL (override)
variables.description: Full GUI URL override, e.g. https://admin.example.com:8889/app/index.html — overrides GUI Hostname/Port/Scheme if set.

variables.name: API / gRPC Port (internal)
variables.description: Internal gRPC API port. Only change if you have a port conflict.

variables.name: Prometheus Metrics Port (internal)
variables.description: Internal Prometheus metrics port. Only change if you have a port conflict.

variables.name: Verbose Server Logs
variables.description: Enable verbose (-v) server logs (DEBUG level). Leave false for INFO only.
